summary: Frame start/end jobs persist width/height from the aspect ratio on image_generation_jobs and pass them to provider.generateImage, but NanoBananaClient uses them only for returned metadata; the Gemini request has reference parts and text only. Inpaint masks are uploaded and stored in frames.last_inpaint_mask_path, while inpaintImage (the only mask-aware method) has zero callers; the inpaint job sends the current frame image as a reference plus a text suffix.

title: C19 Streamline commit never reads formatChoice; commit is not idempotent (a retry after success duplicates versions and rows)
summary: formatChoice never leaves the browser; the commit chooses content by presence of formattedText/formattedBeats, so an as-is choice after an AI-format run still commits AI text.
